ICSE 2027 (Synthetic Fixture) Paper #2 FlagLint: Consistent Names for Feature Flags
===========================================================================

Review #2A [r2]
===========================================================================

Overall merit
-------------
2. Weak reject

Reviewer expertise
------------------
Y. I am knowledgeable in this area.

Paper summary
-------------
The paper studies how developers name feature flags in 120 open-source services and proposes a naming checker called “FlagLint” that flags inconsistent prefixes.

Strengths
---------
The dataset is large, the checker’s rules are documented in the appendix, and the survey with 54 developers supports the claim that consistent names matter.

Weaknesses
----------
The survey questions are not included, so it is unclear how “consistency” was defined for the participants. The paper argues the checker reduces incidents but reports no incident data.

Detailed comments for authors
-----------------------------
I would like to see the precision of the checker on a held-out set of services and a short discussion of false positives in the “legacy” category.
